cobalt.name: Cobalt System / 钴蓝几何
cobalt.use_for: Brand, identity, product strategy and polished corporate decks.
cobalt.art_direction: clean studio stationery and product photography, cobalt blue and lemon yellow props on ivory paper, crisp daylight, minimal geometric composition

mono.name: Mono Acid / 黑白酸黄
mono.use_for: Premium proposals, strategy, product and executive decks; the default for most requests.
mono.art_direction: monochrome studio photography of obsidian and glass sculpture, soft grey backdrop, dramatic single light, black and white, premium and calm

consulting.name: Consulting / 咨询叙事
consulting.use_for: Business reviews, board and management reporting, consulting recommendations, finance.
consulting.art_direction: corporate architecture photography, glass and steel facades, muted navy tones, overcast daylight, precise and calm

ink.name: Ink Landscape / 水墨东方
ink.use_for: Chinese culture, tea, heritage and lifestyle brands, cultural tourism, Eastern aesthetics.
ink.art_direction: traditional Chinese ink wash landscape painting, misty layered mountains, rice paper texture, monochrome with a single touch of vermilion, generous empty space

gradient.name: Soft Gradient / 柔光渐变
gradient.use_for: Product launches, SaaS, AI and consumer tech, modern startup pitches.
gradient.art_direction: soft 3D abstract shapes, glossy glass spheres and ribbons, pastel pink lavender and peach gradient lighting, clean studio render

starlit.name: Starlit / 星夜金
starlit.use_for: Launch events, premium brands, awards, keynotes and annual galas (dark navy with gold).
starlit.art_direction: cinematic night sky over a quiet landscape, countless stars, warm golden light, deep navy blue, elegant and calm

pop.name: Pop Color / 活力色块
pop.use_for: Marketing campaigns, events, consumer brands, training and community decks.
pop.art_direction: saturated studio photography of cheerful people and props against bright solid color backdrops, playful, high energy, crisp light

editorial.name: Editorial / 杂志编辑
editorial.use_for: Research, academic talks, culture, publishing, reports that read like a magazine.
editorial.art_direction: warm editorial portrait and still-life photography, film grain, mustard and vermilion tones, natural window light

neon.name: Neon Grid / 霓虹科技
neon.use_for: Technology, AI, engineering, developer and data platform decks (dark).
neon.art_direction: futuristic data center and abstract circuitry, dark background with neon lime and violet light trails, cinematic, sharp

aurora.name: Aurora Mesh / 极光网格
aurora.use_for: AI-native startups, seed and Series A pitches, developer and AI products.
aurora.art_direction: luminous violet and magenta mesh-gradient light with soft abstract depth, minimal, calm, no objects

documentary.name: Documentary / 纪实大字
documentary.use_for: Mission-driven startups, climate, health and marketplace pitches told through real people.
documentary.art_direction: documentary reportage photography of real people at work, natural light, candid moment, slight film grain, muted colour

periwinkle.name: Periwinkle UI / 长春花
periwinkle.use_for: Consumer apps, SaaS and fintech pitches where the product screen is the hero.
periwinkle.art_direction: a clean mobile app screen with simple cards, charts and buttons, flat UI in periwinkle and white, no readable text

signal.name: Signal Space / 信号黄
signal.use_for: Growth-stage and consumer pitches led by one bold metric; dark keynote rooms.
signal.art_direction: a sleek phone showing a dark app dashboard with one bright yellow chart, deep black space background, product photography

plain.name: Plain Text / 纯文字
plain.use_for: Seed pitches and demo days where the argument carries the deck: one claim per slide, nothing else.
plain.art_direction: simple honest product photography on a plain white background, natural light, no styling

swiss.name: Swiss Grid / 瑞士网格
swiss.use_for: Data-heavy investor updates, fintech and B2B decks with many numbers.
swiss.art_direction: precise architectural photography of modern concrete and glass, strong geometry, neutral grey with one orange accent

keynote.name: Keynote Stage / 发布会舞台
keynote.use_for: Product launches, keynotes and big announcements: one idea, one number or one product per slide.
keynote.art_direction: studio product photography on pure black, dramatic rim light, the object floating alone, no props, no reflections

stripe.name: Stripe Wave / 渐变波浪
stripe.use_for: Platform and fintech launches, developer products, metrics-led product updates.
stripe.art_direction: a clean payments dashboard UI with charts and cards, soft shadows, white and blurple, cropped at the edge, no readable text

bloom.name: Bloom / 花影
bloom.use_for: Lifestyle, beauty, hospitality and consumer brands; brand stories, launches and proposals that should feel light and airy.
bloom.art_direction: soft-focus nature and lifestyle photography, shallow depth of field, airy pastel daylight, flowers, sky and petals, no text

velvet.name: Velvet Glow / 丝绒光
velvet.use_for: AI products, creative tech and launch events; pitches and keynotes that should feel cinematic and new.
velvet.art_direction: cinematic violet and magenta light, silky gradients, soft glow, abstract depth, no objects, no text

photo.name: Photo Essay / 影像
photo.use_for: Brand stories, travel, hospitality, real estate, culture and any deck carried by its photographs.
photo.art_direction: cinematic editorial photography, natural light, shallow depth of field, calm colour grade, quiet negative space on one side for text
